function: No learned component: the reinforcement learning policy reduces to the closed-form combining weight of Theorem 1 and eq. (23), computed from error variances without training (pp. 3-4).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. The letter calls its data-aided channel estimator reinforcement learning, but p. 3 says "the optimal policy is simplified from the following theorem" after fixing eta = 0 and the most likely transition, and Theorem 1 (eq. 22-23, p. 3-4) gives a closed-form weight alpha = e_mod / (e_data + e_mod) from error variances. Algorithm 1 (p. 4) is an online recursive update. The paper has no neural network, no training data, no training phase and no trained parameter; the offline process (p. 4) only estimates the initial error variance. If the reviewer reads the MDP and reinforcement learning framing as learning, the work would fall in area 2 (channel estimation, NMSE and FER).
